author_crosscheck.tool: R 4.5.2 (2025-10-31), base stats only: qbeta, pbeta, lbeta, lchoose, binom.test
author_crosscheck.note: R's pbeta is the TOMS 708 algorithm of Didonato and Morris (1992) and qbeta inverts it after AS 109, implementations independent of SciPy's Boost; the beta-binomial predictive was written from lchoose and lbeta, since base R has no beta-binomial; every value agrees with the lab to the digits R printed
